description: Search every article and news brief by words, section, tags, author and date range, in French or English. Accent-insensitive keyword match first, then pieces close in meaning (match: semantic) when keywords find few. An empty query lists the newest pieces first. Returns JSON {results: [{id, title, url, summary, published, ...}], next, total}; next is the cursor for the following page.

author.description: An author's slug or name, e.g. amerruki.

category.description: Section: hist history, cult culture, pol politics, actu current affairs, sport, eco economy.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. zellige, Tanger Med, Guerre des Sables.

since.description: today, week, month, year, or a date (2026-09-01).

tags.description: Every tag must be present, in French or English, e.g. ["Casablanca", "Finance"].

type.description: article for long-form features, news for briefs.

name: search

next.description: Cursor for the next page, absent at the end.

category.description: hist, cult, pol, actu, sport or eco.

featured.description: On the front page (a la une).

id.description: news/<slug> or articles/<slug>, the id every piece tool accepts.

match.description: keyword for a word match, semantic for a match in meaning.

title: Search articles and news
